sources.source_name: PepsiCo: Quaker Merger, Supplemental SEC Financial Statements
sources.notes: SEC exhibit records August 2, 2001 completion of Quaker Oats merger and combined Gatorade beverage operations. Historical restated financial comparisons are not described as future organic growth.

Retrospective 2005 operations: North American beverage revenue rose 10%, with strong Gatorade/Aquafina growth and new Gatorade Lemonade/Aquafina FlavorSplash; Frito-Lay North America revenue grew 8%. The extra reporting week contributed one point to beverage revenue growth and two points to Frito-Lay revenue growth.

Retrospective in-window operations: 2004 North American volume flat and Coca-Cola C2 weaker than expected; Coca-Cola Zero launched in North America in 2005; worldwide 2005 volume grew 4%, and North American volume 2%.

sources.source_name: Microsoft: Strong Revenue Growth, Fiscal 2005 (SEC exhibit)
sources.notes: Fiscal year ended June 30, 2005: revenue $39.79 billion, net income $12.25 billion, SQL Server growth, Xbox growth, and $44 billion returned through dividends and repurchases. For the June 2005 endpoint, this is retrospective evidence of operations completed within the window, not an in-window July announcement.
